title: Route an activity change adding a service and a UI button
setup: An LMS checkout contains mod_bigbluebuttonbn. The task concerns its Moodle integration.
prompt: Add a web-service function and a teacher-only button to the BigBlueButton activity. Which workflows should you use before changing files?
checks: Select plugin development, external API and access guidance.
Select PHPUnit for server behavior and consider Behat for the teacher/student interaction.
Avoid treating the task as a BigBlueButton server deployment.
